criticalChecks.title: actual full Chrome version matches the exact certified browser version requirement
live host matches a certified adapter record (exact version + adapter + contract + catalog profile)
catalog reports a certified (hostVersion, adapterId, contractHash, catalogProfile) quadruple
a second real page in the same profile applies wallpaper/position changes through storage events without reload loops
clearing wallpaper in page A clears page B through the same sync path
legacy v1 flat records hydrate position 50/50 without clearing wallpaper, persist as v2 on the next change, and corrupt records are ignored
valid preset import shows a diff with the changed style/wallpaper/effects/position
preset apply switches style + wallpaper + effects + position together from one confirmed action
invalid presets are rejected with a stable preset-error id and ARIA invalid/describedby/errormessage
injected wallpaper-persistence failure applies the style, shows an explicit retry (no false success), and retry applies wallpaper with coherent attribution
nine-grid position applies to page/overlay/hero for remote wallpapers and persists as state-v2 position
clear-local-data keeps the current wallpaper, reports a result, and clears disposable local history/cache
importing and applying the exported style preset restores the CSS-only style selection through the sidecar
preset v2 attribution URLs survive import/apply into the selection and render as safe new-tab links
opening the wallpaper page defaults to Online and automatically performs exactly one Random batch
the first activation of the Online tab performs exactly one Wikimedia Commons batch for Auto (no mount-time batch)
the Online tab exposes a native provider <select> with Auto and the three reviewed keyless sources (Openverse is not offered)
Auto names the provider that served the results in a polite live region
the Built-in tab renders exactly the 8 curated offline swatches in order
a collapsed Classic group holds the other 16 designs, every one of the 24 ids renders exactly once
Follow style is a single-select preset card; selecting it renders the generated style hero and clears the image-only controls
a CC BY result renders creator/licence/source links as safe new-tab https anchors and keeps them in the selection
the Livery bundle detail page renders the live-build badge, the facts section and the Open Livery / hot-update actions
Livery detail contributions render nothing for other bundles, rows and official items
host MenuSurface --dsw-menu-surface-fill resolves fully opaque under a Livery style
host Settings modal stays opaque above frost+atmosphere
sidebar selected accent stays visibly distinct from the sidebar fill
a direct search-only source exposes Search and hides Random instead of rendering disabled clutter or helper copy
